inputs.label: OBF survival design
inputs.prompt: Design a one-sided 0.025 O'Brien-Fleming survival trial with looks at 33%, 67%, and 100% information, hazard ratio 0.65, 90% power, and explicit dropout and follow-up assumptions. Return executable boundaries and sample-size evidence.

inputs.label: Blinded variance SSR
inputs.prompt: Implement a blinded internal-pilot variance sample-size re-estimation for a continuous endpoint, comparing assumed SD 12 with observed blinded SD 14 while preserving a one-sided 0.025 final test.

inputs.label: Promising-zone combination design
inputs.prompt: Implement a Mehta-Pocock promising-zone re-estimation with inverse-normal or Cui-Hung-Wang weights, conditional-power zones 30% to 80%, a maximum sample size, and evidence that Type-I error remains controlled.

inputs.label: BOIN operating characteristics
inputs.prompt: Generate a BOIN table for six doses, target toxicity 0.30, cohorts of three, maximum n=30, and reproducible operating characteristics under the supplied six-dose toxicity curve.

inputs.label: CRM comparator
inputs.prompt: Run 1,000 CRM trials on the same six-dose toxicity curve and compare MTD selection and overdose allocation with BOIN using a calibrated six-dose skeleton and a recorded seed.

inputs.label: EXNEX basket borrowing
inputs.prompt: Construct an EXNEX basket design in which rare-disease strata can borrow but an outlying stratum can detach; report mixture weights, prior-data conflict sensitivity, and effective sample size.

inputs.label: Run all shipped adaptive examples
inputs.prompt: Execute the packaged adaptive_designs.R end to end and treat every numbered section as a finished implementation suitable for an SAP, including enrichment, I-SPY-style graduation, and response-adaptive randomisation.
